# Agentic Media Lab

> Which skill, renderer and model to use when a coding agent makes your video - with runs you can repeat. Records: 72 (45 tool, 13 model, 14 source, 0 recipe). Concepts: 35. Pages: 2. Size: about 72690 tokens (estimate, characters / 4).

## Entry points

- [Index](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/INDEX.md): concept tree with counts and the hub size
- [Catalog](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/README.md): every record by kind, inactive records listed separately
- [Data schema](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/docs/SCHEMA.md): Use this page when you need the exact record fields, allowed values, id rules or how the evidence badge is derived.
- [Glossary](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/docs/glossary.md): Use this page when a term in the hub is unclear or you need a concept id.
- [All records as JSON lines](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/index/records.jsonl): the full machine dump
- [README.md](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/README.md): what the hub is
- [AGENTS.md](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/AGENTS.md): how agents query and extend the hub

## Records

- [Kokoro-82M](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/model/hexgrad__kokoro.md): model, quoted-primary. It gives an agent a free, local narration voice with commercial use allowed, small enough to run beside a video model.
- [Z-Image](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/model/tongyi-mai__z-image.md): model, quoted-primary. It is the small, permissive image model with published memory numbers on a 64 GB Apple Silicon Mac, which makes it the default for local ...
- [Run Claude Code programmatically (claude -p)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/code.claude.com__docs__en__headless.md): source, quoted-primary. claude -p is what a system crontab, launchd job or CI runner calls; this page sets what such a run may do without a person.
- [Claude Code cloud scheduled tasks (formerly routines)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/code.claude.com__docs__en__routines.md): source, quoted-primary. The only option in this lane that keeps firing with the laptop shut and needs no server of your own, at the cost of no local files.
- [Claude Code: run prompts on a schedule (/loop) and compare scheduling options](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/code.claude.com__docs__en__scheduled-tasks.md): source, quoted-primary. The comparison table answers where each Claude Code schedule runs and what must stay on, in one place.
- [GitHub Actions: deployments and environments (required reviewers)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/docs.github.com__en__actions__reference__workflows-and-actions__deployments-and-environments.md): source, quoted-primary. Required reviewers are the built-in way to make a scheduled workflow stop and wait for a person before a publish or upload step.
- [GitHub Actions: events that trigger workflows (schedule)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/docs.github.com__en__actions__reference__workflows-and-actions__events-that-trigger-workflows.md): source, quoted-primary. A free scheduler for claude -p or codex exec that needs no machine of yours, with documented ways it fails to fire.
- [bb configuration reference](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/github.com__get-bb__bb__blob__main__docs__configuration.md.md): source, quoted-primary. It names the two settings that decide how unattended a scheduled bb run really is, and the one network setting that exposes command ...
- [bb automations: script runtime reference](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/github.com__get-bb__bb__blob__main__plugins__automations__skills__automations__references__script-runtime.md.md): source, quoted-primary. It states how a failed or overlapping scheduled run behaves, which decides whether a nightly render job can double-fire or silently stop.
- [Hermes Agent security: dangerous command approval](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/hermes-agent.nousresearch.com__docs__user-guide__security.md): source, quoted-primary. It states exactly what a cron job does when it hits a command that needs a person, and how approvals reach you in Slack, Telegram or ...
- [Codex non-interactive mode (codex exec)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/learn.chatgpt.com__docs__non-interactive-mode.md): source, quoted-primary. codex exec is the Codex counterpart of claude -p: what a cron job or CI runner calls when the reader's agent is Codex.
- [Remotion's Model Context Protocol (shut down)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/remotion.dev__docs__ai__mcp.md): source, quoted-primary. A vendor's own account of choosing skills over an MCP server for code-driven video.
- [generative-media-skills](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/calesthio__generative-media-skills.md): tool, quoted-primary. It is the only candidate found that covers caption limits, delivery specs and character continuity in one place, with a caption validator ...
- [claude-code-video-toolkit](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/digitalsamba__claude-code-video-toolkit.md): tool, quoted-primary. Its design rules address the most common amateur tells: wrapped titles, drifting alignment, colour changes with no reason.
- [FFmpeg](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/ffmpeg__ffmpeg.md): tool, quoted-primary. An agent can finish or assemble a clip with FFmpeg alone, and most render failures that reach the reader are FFmpeg input mismatches.
- [bb](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/get-bb__bb.md): tool, quoted-primary. The closest fit found for a single developer who wants a scheduled Claude Code or Codex run on their own Mac, with run history and a ...
- [whisper.cpp](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/ggml-org__whisper.cpp.md): tool, quoted-primary. It gives an agent a local transcript with timestamps for captions, on the Mac GPU, from one command.
- [GSAP](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/greensock__gsap.md): tool, quoted-primary. Most HTML video an agent writes moves with GSAP, so its licence travels with every HyperFrames clip.
- [HyperFrames](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/heygen-com__hyperframes.md): tool, quoted-primary. One of the two renderers most agent-made video runs on, and its skill carries numeric motion, review and loudness rules.
- [ffmpeg-skill](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/kajisho5__ffmpeg-skill.md): tool, quoted-primary. It is the clearest delivery skill found: platform checks on the output file, numbers in the report, and a contact sheet the agent must view ...
- [Manim Community Edition](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/manimcommunity__manim.md): tool, quoted-primary. The usual route for diagram and equation animation written by an agent in Python, with a one-flag way to get the last frame as a PNG.
- [MFLUX](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/mflux-community__mflux.md): tool, quoted-primary. It is the shortest documented path from a coding agent to a local image or upscale on Apple Silicon: one shell command per image, no server.
- [mlx-whisper](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/ml-explore__mlx-examples__whisper.md): tool, quoted-primary. It is the pip-installable way for an agent on a Mac to get a transcript file without compiling anything.
- [motion-graphics (Mort1d)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/mort1d__motion-graphics-skills.md): tool, quoted-primary. It fixes a master spec, forbids copying reference material, and makes the agent critique until every score is 8 or more before the final ...
- [Remotion](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/remotion-dev__remotion.md): tool, quoted-primary. The most established code renderer an agent can drive locally, and the one most skills target. Its licence is the first thing to check ...
- [Remotion Agent Skills](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/remotion-dev__skills.md): tool, quoted-primary. The reference skills for the other dominant renderer. They state support for Codex and Cursor as well as Claude Code.

## Optional

- [ACE-Step 1.5](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/model/ace-step__ace-step.md): model, quoted-primary. It gives a local soundtrack with a stated permission for commercial use of the output, and its macOS scripts use MLX.
- [FLUX 3 Image Klein](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/model/black-forest-labs__flux-3-image-klein.md): model, quoted-secondary. It does generation and multi-reference editing in one model with measured memory on a 64 GB Mac, but its licence caps paid work by the ...
- [SeedVR2](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/model/bytedance-seed__seedvr.md): model, quoted-primary. Upscaling is a cheap last step to make a local clip or still look finished, and mflux ships an MLX upscale command for it.
- [Gemini Omni Flash](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/model/google__gemini-omni-flash.md): model, quoted-primary. It is the replacement Google names for Veo 3.1 on the Gemini API.
- [Veo 3.1](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/model/google__veo-3.1.md): model, quoted-primary. Code and skills that call Veo through the Gemini API need to migrate.
- [LTX-2](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/model/lightricks__ltx-2.md): model, quoted-primary. It is the open video model with the most documented Mac routes: the official PyTorch code on MPS, mlx-video for LTX-2 and 2.3, and Draw ...
- [MiniMax H3](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/model/minimaxai__minimax-h3.md): model, quoted-primary. A leading open-weights video model whose licence does not cover several major regions.
- [Sora 2](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/model/openai__sora-2.md): model (archived), quoted-primary. Many guides and skills still call it. Anything that depends on the Videos API no longer runs.
- [Qwen-Image](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/model/qwen__qwen-image.md): model, quoted-primary. It runs on a 64 GB Mac with published timings, but version 2.1 is licensed for research and evaluation only.
- [Vimoo 1.0](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/model/vimoo-ai__vimoo-1.0.md): model, quoted-primary. It is the one open video model whose own vendor publishes an Apple Silicon package with a CLI, under Apache 2.0.
- [Wan 2.2](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/model/wan-ai__wan2.2.md): model, quoted-primary. It is the main Apache-2.0 video family with a documented MLX route on a Mac, so client work carries no revenue cap.
- [Using bb on multiple devices](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/github.com__get-bb__bb__blob__main__docs__multiple-devices.md.md): source, quoted-primary. It answers what must stay running for a bb schedule to fire: the server machine, awake.
- [HyperFrames vs Remotion research note (GenMotion)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/github.com__haxzie__genmotion__blob__main__docs__research__hyperframes-remotion.md.md): source, quoted-secondary. The only source found that says how HyperFrames capture differs on macOS, which is the reader's machine.
- [HyperFrames vs Remotion (HeyGen guide)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/hyperframes.heygen.com__guides__hyperframes-vs-remotion.md): source, quoted-secondary. The vendor of one side states where the other is better and admits HyperFrames fails quietly when its rules are broken. Read it as a party ...
- [Codex scheduled tasks (ChatGPT app)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/learn.chatgpt.com__docs__automations.md): source, quoted-primary. The Codex-side answer to scheduled agent runs with a review inbox, for readers who use Codex rather than Claude Code.
- [Kinetograph](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/0xs4n4tg__kinetograph.md): tool, quoted-primary. It could give Remotion or HyperFrames code a render path with no Chrome, and its docs list in detail what it cannot draw. The repo was ...

- [Activepieces](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/activepieces__activepieces.md): tool, quoted-primary. A permissive alternative to n8n, but its documented approval feature gates publishing a flow, not a step inside a run.
- [MCP for Blender](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/ahujasid__mcp-for-blender.md): tool, quoted-primary. The working path for 3D shots driven by an agent, with a built-in way for the agent to see its own frames.
- [mlx-video](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/blaizzy__mlx-video.md): tool, quoted-primary. It is the documented MLX path for the two main open video families, with a command an agent can call and an MP4 as output.
- [video-use](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/browser-use__video-use.md): tool, quoted-primary. The clearest example of a skill that inspects its own output at every cut before handing it over.
- [ComfyUI](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/comfy-org__comfyui.md): tool, quoted-primary. Many model vendors ship ComfyUI workflows first, and comfy-cli gives an agent a command to run them locally on a Mac.
- [marketingskills (video, product-demo-recording)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/coreyhaines31__marketingskills.md): tool, quoted-primary. Screen demos are the most common developer clip, and this reference fixes their usual tells: an invisible cursor, captions covering the ...
- [fframes](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/dmtrkovalenko__fframes.md): tool, quoted-secondary. A browser-free renderer aimed at agent iteration speed. Its speed claim against Remotion is the vendor's own and unmeasured here.
- [remotion-superpowers](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/dojocodinglabs__remotion-superpowers.md): tool, quoted-primary. Its review command does a cheap local frame check first, then a scored AI watch of the full render, and tells the agent to trust its own ...
- [Draw Things](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/drawthings.ai.md): tool, quoted-primary. Its release log is the most up-to-date record of which open models run on a Mac at all, including LTX-2.3, MiniMax H3 and FLUX 3 Image ...
- [smooth-animation-skill](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/flchntc__smooth-animation-skill.md): tool, quoted-primary. It replaces 'looks choppy' with a measured number and a fixed order of fixes, and it re-measures the final file.
- [claude-remotion-skill](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/haidrrrry__claude-remotion-skill.md): tool, quoted-primary. Adds the frame-inspection step the official Remotion skills leave to a person.
- [motion-skills (iArt)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/iart-ai__motion-skills.md): tool, quoted-primary. The verify scripts are a renderer-neutral review loop: look at three frames on one sheet, then assert resolution, codec, fps and duration ...
- [claude-video-vision](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/jordanrendric__claude-video-vision.md): tool, quoted-primary. It gives Claude eyes on a finished render, which any renderer's review loop can use when its own skill has no frame-inspection step.
- [claude-plugin-marketplace (ffmpeg-kinetic-captions)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/josiahsiegel__claude-plugin-marketplace.md): tool, quoted-primary. It gives exact word-pop timings and a reading-time formula, which is the kinetic-caption craft most other skills leave as 'make captions ...
- [motion-design skill (LottieFiles)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/lottiefiles__motion-design-skill.md): tool, quoted-primary. Its checklist turns motion taste into checks an agent can tick before rendering, with a stated severity for each miss.
- [motion-video-director (mattypark)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/mattypark__motion-graphics-skill.md): tool, quoted-primary. It is the candidate with the most explicit asset rules: a manifest with source and licence for every downloaded file, and no font shipped ...
- [Revideo](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/midrender__revideo.md): tool, quoted-primary. It gives the Motion Canvas authoring model a render call an agent can run, and it names Claude and Codex as authors.
- [editly](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/mifi__editly.md): tool, quoted-primary. A declarative format an agent can write without a frame model, with a `--fast` flag for a low-cost preview render.
- [Motion Canvas](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/motion-canvas__motion-canvas.md): tool, quoted-primary. Good for code explainers synced to voice-over, but its render step is a button in a browser editor, which an agent cannot press without ...
- [n8n](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/n8n-io__n8n.md): tool, quoted-primary. Self-hosted n8n gives a single developer a scheduler plus a Slack or Telegram approval before an agent tool runs, for example before a ...
- [html-video](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/nexu-io__html-video.md): tool, quoted-primary. A wrapper that drives Claude Code or Codex as a subprocess and ships 21 templates; only the HyperFrames engine works so far.
- [Hermes Agent](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/nousresearch__hermes-agent.md): tool, quoted-primary. It is a full agent, not a wrapper for Claude Code, and its cron plus chat approvals is the most complete unattended loop with a human ...
- [Kanban Video Pipeline](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/nousresearch__kanban-video-pipeline.md): tool, quoted-primary. A worked example of an agent video pipeline driven by a task board instead of a person, with a block-and-notify path when something fails.
- [OpenMontage](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/openmontageinc__openmontage.md): tool, quoted-primary. Its reviewer skill makes every critical finding carry a concrete fix and bounds revision rounds, and its typography skill has per-platform ...
- [Temporal](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/temporalio__temporal.md): tool, quoted-primary. The heaviest option here, but the one with explicit, documented rules for overlapping and late runs.
- [Trigger.dev](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/triggerdotdev__trigger.dev.md): tool, quoted-primary. Waitpoint tokens give code-first approval: a render task waits for an 'approved' or 'rejected' payload before it publishes.
- [video-shotcraft](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/vincentwei1021__video-shotcraft.md): tool, quoted-primary. It makes the reviewer a different agent from the maker, which is the strongest review-loop rule found so far.
- [Windmill](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/windmill-labs__windmill.md): tool, quoted-primary. Its suspend-until-approval step is a run-time human gate in the free edition, which fits a 'render, then wait for my OK, then publish' flow.
- [MoviePy](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/zulko__moviepy.md): tool, quoted-primary. Easy for an agent to script in Python, but agent training data is full of v1 code that v2 broke.
